subject: Interview Invitation for Software Engineer - MLOps

subject: Complete your coding assessment for Path AI

subject: Thank You – Figma Final Round

subject: Update on Your DeepMind Application

subject: Thanks for Applying – No Interview
body: Thank you for applying to the Research Scientist role at Adobe. While your background is impressive, we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.
